    "FUNCTION view_maintenance_no_dialog.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IMPORT_MODE) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IMPORT_SPEC_MODE) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(TOT_NAME) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(EXT_NAME) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION) TYPE  VIMTY_TCODE DEFAULT 'EDIT'",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFC_DESTINATION_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT",
    "*\"       ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(UPDATE_REQUIRED)",
    "*\"     VALUE(RESULTS) LIKE  VIMMODRES STRUCTURE  VIMMODRES",
    "*\"     VALUE(LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE) TYPE  VIMTY_MESSAGE",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      CORR_KEYTAB STRUCTURE  E071K",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      DPL_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      EXTRACT",
    "*\"      TOTAL",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"      IX_TO_MODIFY STRUCTURE  VIMMODIX",
    "*\"      IMPORT_RESULTS TYPE  SLCTR_TABLES_KEYS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      MISSING_CORR_NUMBER",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* SW: neuer Wert für VIMMODIX-ACTION -> UPI",
    "*     gleiche Bedeutung wie UPD, jedoch wird Originaleintrag und",
    "*     zu übernehmender Eintrag in Total übergeben (im Import genutzt)",
    "* MF: neuer Wert für VIMMODIX-ACTION -> DEI",
    "*     gleiche Bedeutung wie DEL, jedoch wird Originaleintrag und",
    "*     zu löschender Eintrag in Total übergeben (BCSet-Import)",
    "",
    "  DATA: restore_local_memory(1) TYPE c, h_lg TYPE i,",
    "        texttablength type i,",
    "        name_for_restore LIKE vimdesc-viewname,",
    "        dummytc TYPE vimty_tcode,",
    "        state_name(30) TYPE c VALUE 'STATUS_', nbr_of_del TYPE i,",
    "        fpool_name LIKE trdir-name, i_action(1) TYPE c,                      \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        dummy_tab LIKE vimexclfun OCCURS 1, fb_rc TYPE i,",
    "        mem_id(42) TYPE c, h_status LIKE vimstatus, counter_safe TYPE i,",
    "        udl_trans_patt(6) TYPE c, upd_trans_patt(4) TYPE c,",
    "        del_trans_patt(6) TYPE c, firstline_safe TYPE i,",
    "      delete_flags(3) TYPE c, set_state(1) TYPE c, nextline_safe TYPE i,  \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        calmode_safe(1) TYPE c, vmnd_results LIKE vimmodres,",
    "        looplines_safe LIKE looplines, calcls_safe TYPE vcl_name,",
    "        i_uselcltbl(1) TYPE c, index_safe TYPE i.",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <extract_x> type x, <x_action>, <x_key>, <x_mrk>,",
    "                 <extract_c> type c.",
    "",
    "  calmode_safe = called_by_cluster. calcls_safe = calling_cluster.",
    "  READ TABLE x_header INDEX 1.",
    "  fpool_name   = x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING 'VIM_ACT_DYNP_VIEW' 'C'",
    "                                           name_for_restore h_lg.",
    "  IF name_for_restore NE space AND name_for_restore NE view_name.",
    "    restore_local_memory = 'X'.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'COUNTER' 'I'",
    "                                             counter_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'FIRSTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             firstline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'NEXTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             nextline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'LOOPLINES' 'I'",
    "                                             looplines_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'EXIND' 'I'",
    "                                             index_safe h_lg.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  mem_id = sy-uname. mem_id+12(*) = view_name.",
    "  TRANSLATE mem_id USING ' _'.",
    "  EXPORT extract TO MEMORY ID mem_id.",
    "  h_lg = x_header-after_tabc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "  texttablength =",
    "   x_header-aft_txttbc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "*  h_lg = x_header-tablen.",
    "  IF x_header-bastab NE space AND x_header-texttbexst NE space.",
    "    ADD texttablength TO h_lg.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  state_name+7 = x_header-maintview.   \"Subviews",
    "  ASSIGN: extract to <extract_c> casting,",
    "          extract to <extract_x> casting,",
    "          <extract_c>+h_lg(1) TO <x_action>, <x_action>+1(1) TO <x_mrk>,",
    "          <extract_x>(x_header-keylen) TO <x_key>.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING state_name 'VIMSTATUS'",
    "                                           h_status h_lg.",
    "  MOVE: geloescht TO delete_flags, neuer_geloescht TO delete_flags+1,",
    "        update_geloescht TO delete_flags+2.",
    "  IF tot_name NE space AND ext_name NE space.",
    "    i_uselcltbl = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF action EQ 'EDIT'.",
    "    MOVE: geloescht TO udl_trans_patt, zurueckholen TO udl_trans_patt+1,",
    "          neuer_geloescht TO udl_trans_patt+2,",
    "          zurueckholen TO udl_trans_patt+3,",
    "          update_geloescht TO udl_trans_patt+4,",
    "          zurueckholen TO udl_trans_patt+5,",
    "          original TO upd_trans_patt, aendern TO upd_trans_patt+1,",
    "          neuer_eintrag TO upd_trans_patt+2,",
    "          aendern TO upd_trans_patt+3,",
    "          original TO del_trans_patt, geloescht TO del_trans_patt+1,",
    "          aendern  TO del_trans_patt+2,",
    "          update_geloescht TO del_trans_patt+3,",
    "          neuer_eintrag TO del_trans_patt+4,",
    "          neuer_geloescht TO del_trans_patt+5.",
    "    REFRESH extract.",
    "    SORT ix_to_modify BY tot_index.",
    "    LOOP AT ix_to_modify WHERE action NE 'TIN' AND action NE 'TEX'.",
    "      SUBTRACT nbr_of_del FROM ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "      READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "      CASE ix_to_modify-action.",
    "        WHEN 'INS'.",
    "          <x_action> = neuer_eintrag.  \"ignore wrong flags of new entry",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "        WHEN 'COP'.",
    "          <x_action> = kopieren.       \"ignore wrong flags of new entry",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          APPEND extract.              \"destination",
    "          READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-org_tot_ix.",
    "          <x_action> = vim_source_entry. \"source",
    "        WHEN 'UPD'.",
    "          TRANSLATE <x_action> USING upd_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'UPI'.                                         \"SW",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          TRANSLATE <x_action> USING upd_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'UDL'.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING udl_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'DEL'.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING del_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'DEI'.                                         \"MF",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING del_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'TIN'.",
    "          <x_action> = task_add.",
    "        WHEN 'TEX'.",
    "          <x_action> = task_del.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "      APPEND extract.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "      IF import_mode EQ space.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  corr_number                 = corr_number",
    "                  fcode                       = 'EXED'",
    "                  view_action                 = 'U'",
    "                  view_name                   = view_name",
    "                  complex_selconds_used       = complex_selconds_used",
    "               rfc_destination_for_upgrade = rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "             IMPORTING",
    "                  update_required             = update_required",
    "             TABLES",
    "                  corr_keytab                 = corr_keytab",
    "                  dba_sellist                 = dba_sellist",
    "                  dpl_sellist                 = dpl_sellist",
    "                  excl_cua_funct              = dummy_tab",
    "                  extract                     = extract",
    "                  total                       = total",
    "                  x_header                    = x_header",
    "                  x_namtab                    = x_namtab",
    "             EXCEPTIONS",
    "                  missing_corr_number         = 1.",
    "        fb_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "        IF fb_rc EQ 0.",
    "          PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                      USING 'VIM_RESULTS_OF_EXT_MOD'",
    "                                            'VIMMODRES' results h_lg.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.                            \"import mode activ",
    "        PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                            USING i_uselcltbl",
    "                                    import_mode corr_number 'EXED' 'U'",
    "                                    view_name tot_name ext_name",
    "                                    rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "                                    space update_required corr_keytab[]",
    "                                    dba_sellist[] dpl_sellist[]",
    "                                    dummy_tab extract[] total[]",
    "                                    x_header[] x_namtab[] dummytc",
    "                                    sy-tabix results import_results[]",
    "                                    import_spec_mode",
    "                                    complex_selconds_used.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      called_by_cluster = calmode_safe. calling_cluster = calcls_safe.",
    "      REFRESH extract.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSEIF action EQ 'SAVE'.",
    "    PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                        USING i_uselcltbl",
    "                                import_mode corr_number 'SAVE' 'U'",
    "                                view_name tot_name ext_name space space",
    "                                update_required corr_keytab[]",
    "                                dba_sellist[] dpl_sellist[] dummy_tab",
    "                                extract[] total[] x_header[] x_namtab[]",
    "                                dummytc sy-tabix results",
    "                                import_results[] import_spec_mode",
    "                                complex_selconds_used.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  LOOP AT ix_to_modify WHERE action EQ 'TIN' OR action EQ 'TEX'.",
    "    READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "    CASE ix_to_modify-action.",
    "      WHEN 'TIN'.",
    "        <x_action> = task_add.",
    "      WHEN 'TEX'.",
    "        <x_action> = task_del.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    APPEND extract.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              corr_number           = corr_number",
    "              fcode                 = 'EXED'",
    "              view_action           = 'T'",
    "              view_name             = view_name",
    "              complex_selconds_used = complex_selconds_used",
    "         IMPORTING",
    "              update_required       = update_required",
    "         TABLES",
    "              corr_keytab           = corr_keytab",
    "              dba_sellist           = dba_sellist",
    "              dpl_sellist           = dpl_sellist",
    "              excl_cua_funct        = dummy_tab",
    "              extract               = extract",
    "              total                 = total",
    "              x_header              = x_header",
    "              x_namtab              = x_namtab",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              missing_corr_number   = 1.",
    "    fb_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    called_by_cluster = calmode_safe. calling_cluster = calcls_safe.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IMPORT extract FROM MEMORY ID mem_id.",
    "  IF fb_rc EQ 0.",
    "    LOOP AT extract.",
    "      READ TABLE total INTO extract WITH KEY <x_key> BINARY SEARCH. \"#EC WARNOK",
    "      IF <x_action> CO delete_flags AND h_status-st_delete NE geloescht.",
    "        DELETE extract.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        MODIFY extract.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                      USING 'VIM_RESULTS_OF_EXT_MOD'",
    "                                            'VIMMODRES' vmnd_results",
    "                                            h_lg.",
    "    results-nbr_of_tin = vmnd_results-nbr_of_tin.",
    "    results-nbr_of_tex = vmnd_results-nbr_of_tex.",
    "    results-rc_tin = vmnd_results-rc_tin.",
    "    results-rc_tex = vmnd_results-rc_tex.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF restore_local_memory NE space.",
    "    PERFORM vim_restore_local_memory IN PROGRAM (fpool_name).",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'COUNTER' 'I'",
    "                                             counter_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'FIRSTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             firstline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'NEXTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             nextline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'LOOPLINES' 'I'",
    "                                             looplines_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'VIM_ACT_DYNP_VIEW' 'C'",
    "                                             name_for_restore h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'EXIND' 'I'",
    "                                             index_safe h_lg.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF fb_rc NE 0. RAISE missing_corr_number. ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION.                    \"#EC CI_VALPAR"
  ],
